text.en: A farmer grew fruits and took the best of them to the king.

Once there was a farmer who loved fruits. He grew many kinds with hard work and care.
When the fruits were ripe he decided to gift the best fruit to the king.
His wife said that the grapes and watermelons were the best this year. Because the journey to the palace was long and watermelons were too heavy, he took a basket of grapes.
He reached the palace and told the guard he had brought a gift. The guard took him to the royal garden where he saw the king playing with the princess.
The story is about sharing what we have and being thankful for food and the people who grow it.
Say thank you for your food each day.
New words: farmer, ripe, palace, guard, gift.
